eventtitle: Behind the Agents: Building the Foundation for AI at Scale
description: This session explores Grab’s evolving data journey on AWS and the architecture behind its next-generation data and AI platform. Learn how Grab built a unified, governed enterprise data foundation using AWS-native services to support cross-functional reporting, simplify data management across systems, and power internally developed analytics and AI applications. Grab’s Head of Analytics will share key architectural decisions and lessons learned in building a scalable platform that enables real-time insights and supports innovation across the organization.
customCategory: AWS Summit Singapore - Harnessing AI through Data Foundations

speakers.title: Head of Analytics - Data Architecture and EDW, Grab
speakers.name: Sneh Agrawal
